title: Taweez against Scorpions and Serpents
data:
To fend off the stings of scorpions, it is recommended to look sharply at the suha star (a dim star in Ursa Minor) and repeat the following supplicatory prayer three times:
اَللّٰهُمَّ رَبَّ اَسْلَمَ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ عَجِّلْ فَرَجَهُمْ وَ سَلِّمْنَا مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ ذِىْ شَرٍّ.
AALLAAHUMA RABA AASLAMA SALI A'ALAAAA MUHAMADIN WA AAALI MUHAMADIN WA A'AJIL FARAJAHUM WA SALIMNAA MIN SHARI KULI DHIAA SHARIN.
May Allah accept this supplication.
اَللّٰهُمَّ رَبَّ هُوْدِ ابْنِ اُسَيَّةَ اٰمِنِّى شَرَّ كُلِّ عَقْرَبٍ وَ حَيَّةٍ.
AALLAAHUMA RABA HUWDI ABNI AUSAYAHA AAAMINIAA SHARA KULI A'AQRABIN WA HAYAHIN.
May Allah accept this supplication.
بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ وَ بِاللّٰهِ وَ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اٰلِهٖ اَخَذْتُ الْعَقَارِبَ وَالْحَيَّاتِ كُلَّهَا بِاِذْنِ اللّٰهِ تَبارَكَ وَ تَعَالٰى بِاَفْوَاهِهَا وَ اَذْنَابِهَا وَ اَسْمَاعِهَا وَ اَبْصَارِهَا وَ قُوَاهَا عَنِّىْ وَ عَمَّنْ اَحْبَبْتُ اِلٰى ضَحْوَةِ النَّهَارِ اِنْشَاۤءَاللّٰهُ تَعَالٰى.
I WA BII WA SALAAA U A'ALAAAA MUHAMADIN WA AAALIHEE AAKHADHTU ALA'AQAARIBA WAALHAYAATI KULAHAA BIAIDHNI I TABARAKA WA TAA'AALAAAA BIAAFWAAHIHAA WA AADHNAABIHAA WA AASMAAA'IHAA WA AABSAARIHAA WA QUWAAHAA A'ANIAA WA A'AMAN AAHBABTU AILAAAA DAHWAHI ALNAHAARI AINSHAA'AU TAA'AALAAAA.
May Allah accept this supplication.
سَلَامٌ عَلٰى نُوْحٍ فِى الْعَالَمِيْنَ اِنَّا كَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِى الْمُحْسِنِيْنَ اِنَّهٗ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ.
SALAAMUN A'ALAAAA NUWHIN FIAA ALA'AALAMIYNA AINAA KADHAALIKA NAJZIAA ALMUHSINIYNA AINAHU MIN A'IBAADINAA ALMU'MINIYNA.
May Allah accept this supplication.
سَلَامٌ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ عَلٰى نُوْحٍ فِى الْعَالَمِيْنَ.
SALAAMUN A'ALAAAA MUHAMADIN WA AAALI MUHAMADIN WA A'ALAAAA NUWHIN FIAA ALA'AALAMIYNA.
May Allah accept this supplication.
